info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Status API allows organizations to retrieve the current status of applications submitted for various career opportunities. This endpoint serves as a resource for HR teams and hiring managers to track the progress of candidates through the recruitment process. Users can obtain detailed information about application statuses, facilitating better communication with applicants. Typical consumers of this API include recruitment software providers, internal HR systems, and applicant tracking systems seeking to enhance their application management capabilities.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of all applications
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current status of all applications in the system. The response will include details about each application's state, enabling effective monitoring and management.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching the status of applications. This body should contain any necessary information required to retrieve the current status of the applications in question.

200.description: The request was successful, and the application status is returned.

ListCareersApplicationsStatusRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for the GET operation on application status.

ListCareersApplicationsStatusResponse_20.title: Application Status Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the application query.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for tracking the application.

resultId.description: Identifies the result of the application process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the application query, in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message or information about the application status.

ListCareersApplicationsStatusResponse_20.description: Response schema for the application status query, providing details about the status and audit information.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the application.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the application was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the application was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains auditing information related to the application status.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
